scope: Planning consistency only; no runtime or migration version reservation.

Stable namespace-scoped identities and correct Type-only alias handling
Finite allocation without memory-of-memory or telemetry recursion
Atomic import, immutable source occurrences and stable graphs across snapshots
Coverage-audited bounded backfill before authoritative activation
Type owners remain class declarations and use shared effective-contract resolution
Existing inheritance, defaults, cardinalities and fixed/replace/append semantics
Existing Ember wire/hash validation with separate own and value Types
No owner-private content, identity or digest leakage through projections or fallback
Installed typed graph-locator, request and result schemas without fake native kinds
Compatible source-consistent base and relationship sidecar with bounded endpoint validation
Distinct graph perspectives and common-source evidence grouping
Checked evidence targets and revision-specific provenance relationships
Single original immutable candidate and deterministic admission lifecycle
Compare-and-swap accepted heads with atomic lifecycle and outbox
Valid time and recording time with late corrections and disputed states
Constrained applicability, evaluator-versioned caching and targeted invalidation
Restricted-role workspace and graph isolation including composite endpoints
Deterministic complete visible exact lookup and explicit empty/unresolved states
Common eligibility for lexical and independent named-vector spaces
Bounded typed traversal with indivisible qualifications and explicit truncation
Reproducible MemoryBundle packets and explicit context expansion revisions
Installed Cog-only callable operations with one input and one output Type
Canonical start/progress/terminal monitoring and direct causal identities
Collector origin filtering and source-graph-profile replay idempotency
Resumable budgeted consolidation with fencing and generation checks
Derived summary/index/cache lineage and local dirty-path refresh
Authorised forgetting, shared-source retention and deletion-safe restore
Explicit bounded per-target federation without permission propagation
Existing API/CLI/operator surfaces with truthful states and qualified receipts
Matched evidence/quality/cost/freshness evaluations without unsupported gains
Contiguous migrations, safe rollout/rollback and independently verified releases

acceptance.scenario: Every native kind, effective Type, contract Ember and explicitly admitted placeholder receives exactly one graph; empty graphs require zero model calls.
Identical instance references in two namespaces yield distinct graphs; valid Type aliases in one scope converge; invalid instance aliases fail.
Import, contract-bundle and memory-Ember registration allocates finite descriptors without recursive object creation or collector runs.
Concurrent/replayed imports and a later snapshot preserve graph IDs and atomic seals; rollback leaves no published partial coverage.
Old-source backfill resumes after crash, reports visible coverage correctly and blocks feature activation while owners are missing.
A native Type graph resolves inherited declarations/defaults; constructing a Type as `EmberInstance` continues to fail.
Diamond inheritance, fixed/replace/append, cardinality narrowing, instance-required versus effective values and incompatible parents match the existing resolver.
Ember own Type/value Type, catalog/bundle/source revisions and payload schema are checked; equal bytes with different provenance remain distinguishable.
Owner-private fields, identifiers/digests and hidden counts never reach public results, vectors, artifacts or provider input; denial cannot trigger inherited-secret fallback.
A JSON graph locator validates as a locator; unsupported native kinds, fake authority and uninstalled request/result Types fail before dispatch.
Base/sidecar exports share an actual source snapshot boundary; wrong digest, unknown local endpoint, coverage or namespace fails atomically.
Two graph perspectives cite one joint Event and original result; common-source grouping prevents invented independent witnesses or duplicate occurrences.
Evidence variants have actual ownership/target FKs and exactly-one target checks; malformed sources/spans and cross-workspace endpoints fail.
A proposal survives restart independently of admission; deterministic rejection/defer reasons do not change accepted heads.
Two writers admit against the same predecessor: one CAS wins; the other proposal remains recoverable with conflict, and outbox publication is atomic.
Late correction, overlapping disagreement, unknown/open times and `valid_at`/`known_at` queries preserve both historical belief and current applicability.
Version/contract/environment/file changes invalidate only affected assessments and reopen appropriate questions; unsupported guards return `unknown_requires_check`.
Restricted application-role queries reject cross-graph read/write, forged scope and cross-graph local endpoints even when IDs are known.
Exact inventory is complete/deterministic for the visible basis; unresolved, empty and inaccessible states remain distinct without leaking hidden totals.
Lexical and exact vector channels use the same eligible graph population; equal-dimensional incompatible spaces fail and query plans/recall are retained.
Traversal storms, cycles and hubs remain within limits; a necessary exception/contradiction cannot be dropped while retaining its claim.
Concurrent writes produce independently reproducible qualified packets with exact token/template/deployment identities; expansions produce new packets.
Every operation runs through its registered Cog with one input/output Type; wrong signatures, changed handler bindings or raw API/CLI bypass prove zero dispatch.
Real start/progress/terminal and nested tool statistics have direct trigger/emitter/lease identities; missing metrics are unavailable and monitor loss reconciles uncertain effects.
Remembering collector/monitoring Events does not create an unbounded recursive run stream; per-source/graph/profile replay is idempotent.
Consolidation job restart, cancellation and stale lease/source/policy/generation cannot duplicate admission, publish stale content or fabricate completed cost.
Source/policy corrections dirty only dependent summaries/indexes/caches; a missing qualification yields a gap rather than stale guidance.
Forgetting immediately excludes targeted content, finishes the derived closure, preserves unrelated authorised shared evidence and prevents restore/reimport resurrection.
Explicit federation applies per-target access and budgets before expansion/reranking; denied graphs contribute no data or private existence.
CLI/API/operator views show exact owner, states, lineage and real child runs; no-memory/no-access/source-unavailable and requested/completed cancellation are accurate.

Matched held-out synthetic and coding-task ablations report evidence precision/recall, abstention, stale/unsupported use, p50/p95 freshness/latency and full build/query cost; no unearned quality claim.
Upgrade/rollback/restore, full existing CI and Cog/host acceptance pass at exact published source; release assets/hashes/semantic pins and any configured registry are independently read back.
